disabled.title: Evaluation is not enabled
disabled.description: This deployment has not switched on run tracking, so no reviewed cases can be built from runs.

empty.title: No cases yet
empty.description: Candidate cases saved from a Bot's runs appear here as dataset versions.

forbidden.title: You cannot view this Bot's datasets
forbidden.description: Datasets belong to the Bot's creator and administrators; access to the Bot is not enough.

basic.title: Built from basic-level runs
basic.description: The source run was observed at basic level, so a case carries what passed through OpenBot, not the runtime's internal steps.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: Part of this case was withheld by the redaction policy before it was saved.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: Part of this case exceeded the field limit and was cut short; the full content was never stored.

syncing.title: Datasets are still syncing
syncing.description: Saved cases reach this page shortly after they are written; give it a moment.

unavailable.title: Datasets are unavailable
unavailable.description: The evaluation service could not be reached, so datasets cannot be shown right now. Saved versions are not lost.
